name: Slider
summary: Picks one number from a continuous or stepped range by dragging a thumb along a rail. Choose it when the relative position matters more than the exact value (volume, brightness); use a spin button or input when the user must type an exact number.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The current value, when controlled; exclusive with defaultValue.

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: The increment the value snaps to; a positive number. Given a step, the rail shows a tick at each one.

inputs.name: vertical
inputs.description: Runs the rail bottom (min) to top (max).

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Draws the disabled colours and takes no input.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: Called with the new value on every step change, including during a drag.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: An inline 3 × 3 grid: the rail and thumb share the centre cell, the hidden input spans all nine; it carries the colour variables and the focus outline.

anatomy.name: Rail
anatomy.description: The track, painted as one gradient: the progress colour from the start to the value, the rail colour after it.

anatomy.name: Progress
anatomy.description: The filled part of the rail from min to the value; not an element, the first stop of the rail's gradient.

anatomy.name: Step marks
anatomy.description: The rail's ::before: 1px gaps cut into the rail at each step, in colorNeutralBackground1.

anatomy.name: Thumb
anatomy.description: A circle at the value: a brand dot inside a ring of colorNeutralBackground1, edged by a thin colorNeutralStroke1 border. It carries role slider.

anatomy.name: Hidden input
anatomy.description: A transparent native range input over the whole grid; it takes pointer, keyboard and focus.

variants.description: Thumb 20px, rail 4px, thumb centre held 6px from each rail end, root at least 32px tall.
Thumb 16px, rail 2px, thumb centre held 5px from each rail end, root at least 24px tall.
Rail full width at the rail thickness; root at least 120px wide; the thumb centres on its position with translateX(−50%).
Rail full height at the rail thickness; root at least 120px tall; min at the bottom; the thumb centres with translateY(50%).

layout.text: The root is a relative inline-grid, items centred, touch-action none. Horizontal: rows 1fr, thumb size, 1fr and columns 1fr, 100% − thumb size, 1fr, so the rail is inset half a thumb from each end; vertical transposes the tracks.
Medium sets thumb 20px, inner thumb radius 6px, rail 4px and a 32px minimum height; small sets 16px, 5px, 2px and 24px. Horizontal adds a 120px minimum width, vertical a 120px minimum height.

The rail rounds by borderRadiusXLarge and paints a linear gradient along the slider's direction: the progress colour from 0 to the value's percentage, the rail colour from there on. It has a 1px colorTransparentStroke outline (visible only under forced colours) and ignores the pointer.

With a step, the rail's ::before repeats a gradient that is transparent for each step's length less 1px and colorNeutralBackground1 for the last 1px, overhanging each rail end by 1px, so ticks read as notches.

The thumb is a borderRadiusCircular circle of the thumb size filled with the thumb colour, with an inset ring of colorNeutralBackground1 20% of its size wide (4px medium) and a ::before border of colorNeutralStroke1 5% of its size wide (1px medium).
The thumb's centre sits at the value's percentage along the rail, clamped between the inner thumb radius and 100% minus it, so it never overhangs the rail's rounded ends.
The hidden input spans every grid cell; horizontally it is full width and the thumb size tall, vertically full height and the thumb size wide, using a vertical writing mode where supported.

states.text: Rail colorNeutralStrokeAccessible; progress and thumb colorCompoundBrandBackground.
Thumb and progress step to colorCompoundBrandBackgroundHover; the rail does not change. Instant.
While pressed or dragging, thumb and progress are colorCompoundBrandBackgroundPressed.

Keyboard focus draws createFocusOutlineStyle (2px colorStrokeFocus2, borderRadiusMedium) around the root with custom offsets that pull it inward. Horizontal: flush with the root's top and bottom edges and 2px inside its start and end. Vertical: flush top and bottom, 6px outside each side.
Thumb and progress colorNeutralForegroundDisabled, rail colorNeutralBackgroundDisabled, thumb border colorNeutralForegroundDisabled; default cursor, no hover or press.

behaviour.text: Pressing anywhere on the input jumps the value there; dragging moves it, snapping to the nearest step; onChange fires on every step.
Vertical runs min at the bottom to max at the top.
No transition is declared: colour changes and the thumb's movement are instant.
The focus outline appears only for keyboard focus, never after a pointer press.

keyboard: Arrow Left/Down decrease and Arrow Right/Up increase by one step
Page Up and Page Down move by a larger increment
Home and End go to min and max
semantics: a native input type=range, so value, min, max and orientation come from the platform
label it with a Field label or aria-label; give aria-valuetext when the number alone is not meaningful

notes.text: Thumb sizes (16, 20px), inner radii (5, 6px), rail thicknesses (2, 4px), minimum heights (24, 32px), the 120px minimum length, the 20% thumb ring, the 5% thumb border and the 1px step tick are constants in the styles file.
The hit area is the input's cross size, which equals the thumb size (16px small, 20px medium), not the root's 24 or 32px minimum height.
The step ticks and the thumb's inner ring are painted in colorNeutralBackground1, assuming the slider sits on that surface; on another background they show as light notches and a light ring.
The focus outline is pulled inside the root horizontally but pushed outside it vertically: the vertical orientation flips the sign of the side offsets rather than swapping axes.

Under forced colours the rail is CanvasText and the thumb and progress Highlight (also on hover); step ticks are HighlightText; disabled turns rail, thumb and progress GrayText. The rail and thumb opt out of forced adjustment so their gradients survive; the focus outline turns Highlight.
Keyboard increments are the native range input's; the styles file does not state them.
